title: Pin that webkit-verify's inspect() lets a focus-ring failure fail the run
evidence: Done by PR 1721: tools/webkit-verify.test.ts 'H100' runs webkit-verify.mjs as itself with 'playwright' swapped for a fake browser (a module hook); its value page passes and its date box has no ring. It expects a non-zero exit with the ring message and no Back press after the focus step. A try/catch round probeFocusRing in inspect() fails it while the three H90 tests pass. Was: From PR 1704's review (R4). tools/webkit-verify.test.ts's exit-code test ('H90: the gate exits non-zero when the focus step throws at top level') spawns its own script that awaits probeFocusRing, so it proves Node's unhandled-rejection exit, not webkit-verify's wiring. If someone wraps the probeFocusRing call in inspect() (around tools/webkit-verify.mjs:412) in a try/catch, all the H90 tests still pass. Remedy: drive inspect() with a fake browser, or pin that the call is not wrapped. (H100)
